project_type: Next.js 15 + TypeScript + React 19 + Bun application (game/content pipeline dashboard)
build_system: Bun (package manager) + Next.js (framework). All scripts run via bun.
test_framework: Vitest with @testing-library/react, jsdom environment, tests in lib/__tests__/
verification_instructions: 1. bun install 2. bun run type-check 3. bun run build (with SKIP_ENV_VALIDATION=1) 4. bun run test:run
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET mode - full access to registries. Bun 1.2.14 available. SKIP_ENV_VALIDATION=1 needed for build (no real DB/API keys).
contribution_requirements: Use Bun instead of Node.js, npm, pnpm. See CLAUDE.md.
key_patterns: Route handlers use createApiHandler wrapper from lib/middleware/api.ts. Dynamic routes ([id]) access params via ctx.params from ApiContext. The createApiHandler receives Next.js route context as second arg and extracts params. 5 dynamic route files all follow identical pattern.
directory_structure: app/ - Next.js app router (pages + API routes), lib/ - shared code (middleware, db, cache, validation, logging), .github/workflows/ - CI with bun
